title: Count flops against bytes
brief: Compute the flops per byte of a weight matrix, the time one token takes to read the weights, and the batch size at which a chip stops waiting on memory.
hints: A matrix times a batch of B vectors does 2 * B flops per weight (one multiply and one add per vector) and reads b bytes per weight, so the ratio is 2 * B / b.
Decoding one token reads every weight once. The time is the bytes of weights, n_params * bytes_per_elt, divided by the bandwidth in bytes per second.
The ridge point is peak_flops / bandwidth. You need 2 * B / b >= ridge, so B >= ridge * b / 2. Round up, because a batch is a whole number.
